in_sanskrit.name: हरिश्चन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: 'हरि' (hari) - having the qualities of Vishnu, like kindness, morality, and protection and 'शन्द्र' (shandra) - a form of Shiva, the god of destruction

in_marathi.name: Harishchandra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Truth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harishchandra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harishchandra is a name of Vishnu, the Hindu god of truth, dharma, and morality. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Harish’ (having God as the giver) and ‘Chandra’ (moon).

in_bengali.name: Harishchandra
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Truth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Harishchandra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Harishchandra is a name of Vishnu, the Hindu god of truth, dharma, and morality. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Harish’ (having God as the giver) and ‘Chandra’ (moon).
